text: Love is the extremely difficult realisation that something other than oneself is real.
Taking more than you give is not a personality trait. It is a transfer, and someone else is paying for it.
It is okay to be inconvenient. It is very human to be so. No one asked to be here.
Indifference is not neutral once you have power. From there, doing nothing is a thing you did.
You have never once touched the world. You have touched the report of it, and found the report worth having.
Have patience with everything unresolved in your heart. Try to love the questions themselves.
The good things are not free. They cost perspective. You have to know how bad it gets to know what you have.
Every person you passed today is the center of a world as vivid as this one. Almost none of them are extras.
You did not build the road you drove in on. Reciprocity is noticing that, and then behaving as if it is true.
